<function=python>
<parameter=code>

print('result', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','game_over')})
def beam_at(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n')
    pb=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']>=15 and min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])<50:
            bb=n['boundary']; pb=(min(p[0] for p in bb),max(p[0] for p in bb),min(p[1] for p in bb),max(p[1] for p in bb))
    r0,r1,c0,c1=pb; res={}
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        cols=[j for j in range(c1+1,63) if a[r][j] in 'wgW']
        if cols: res[r]=(min(cols),max(cols))
    return pb,res
print('before', beam_at(previous_frame))
print('after ', beam_at(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
